claims.value: Three piece dance costume: decorative head-piece (a); bodice (b) and vegetable fibre skirt (c).

Height: 49 centimetres (a); 45 centimetres (b); 80 centimetres (c). Width: 52 centimetres (a); 38 centimetres (b); 60 centimetres (c). Depth: 3.50 centimetres (a); 15.50 centimetres (b); 9.50 centimetres (c).
Purchased from designer during a British Museum visit to Rapa Nui 2019.

notes.text: 30 September 2026 identity review: the British Museum catalogue identifies 2020,2005.1.a-c as one three-piece dance costume, comprising head-piece (a), bodice (b) and skirt (c). Keep the accession-level group as one MoSA object; the reviewed record gives component measurements but no independent part records or histories. Claims transcribe the catalogue description, object type, production date/place, material, component dimensions and acquisition note. The page attributes design to Celine Bour Manutomatoma and making to Rapanui, but MoSA has no supported creator or maker predicate; the designer’s name also appears in the supported acquisition wording. No image is available in the catalogue capture.
